title: The 4 Best Yoga Mats for Travel
h1: The 4 Best Yoga Mats for Travel
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for yoga mats for travel, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at yoga mats for travel using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: prAna E.C.O. Yoga Mat
products.blurb: Key specs: 5mm closed-cell natural rubber, Two-sided texturing for grip, Non-toxic, PVC-free construction.
strengths: Natural rubber grip holds up well on varied surfaces like hotel carpet or hardwood
5mm thickness is a reasonable middle ground between cushioning and packability
PVC-free build is a plus for travelers minimizing synthetic materials in luggage
limitations: Heavier than dedicated ultralight travel mats at roughly 5 lbs
Rubber smell can be noticeable in a closed suitcase until it airs out

products.name: BalanceFrom GoYoga All-Purpose Yoga Mat
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/4-inch (6mm) high-density foam, Includes carrying strap, Double-sided non-slip texture.
strengths: Cheap enough to not worry about damage or loss during a trip
Included carrying strap makes it easy to sling over a shoulder at the airport
6mm cushioning is comfortable for hotel room or Airbnb floor practice
limitations: Bulkier when rolled than dedicated thin travel mats
Not designed to fold flat for a suitcase the way purpose-built travel mats are
Heavier per inch of thickness than natural rubber alternatives

products.name: Gaiam Essentials Thick Yoga Mat
products.blurb: Key specs: 10mm (2/5-inch) NBR foam cushioning, Easy-cinch carrying strap, Textured non-slip surface.
strengths: 10mm cushioning is comfortable enough to double as a car camping or outdoor picnic mat
Carrying strap keeps it manageable for trunk storage and short carries
limitations: Too bulky for checked or carry-on suitcase packing on a flight
10mm thickness adds unnecessary weight and volume for frequent flyers
Better suited to car travel than air travel

products.name: Manduka PRO Yoga Mat 71-Inch 6mm
products.blurb: Key specs: 6mm closed-cell PVC construction, Lifetime guarantee, Dense, stable cushioning.
strengths: Studio-grade grip and cushioning for travelers relocating temporarily rather than flying short trips
Durable enough to survive being checked as luggage without damage
Familiar full-size feel for practitioners who don't want to compromise on their usual mat
limitations: 26 lbs makes it impractical for carry-on or weight-limited flights
Bulky roll size takes up significant suitcase space
Overkill for short trips where a lighter mat would suffice

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
